exact_derivative_recipe.bilinear_maps: Define B(x,y)=P_K(i(Q dot x_P)y_Q), D_g(x,y)=-sum_(l,r in g)P_K(i(r dot x_l)y_r). Then B(a)=B(a,a), D_g(a)=D_g(a,a).
exact_derivative_recipe.hessian_bilinear: D2G[a][h,k]=Im sum_g c_g (W2_g[h,k] conjugate(Z)+W1_g[h] conjugate(Z1[k])+W1_g[k] conjugate(Z1[h])+W_g conjugate(Z2[h,k])).
exact_derivative_recipe.symmetry: The displayed D2 formula is symmetric in h,k because B2 and D2 are symmetric and the two cross terms swap; Hessian bilinear form is real-valued on the real Fourier tangent space.

formula.P11_endpoint: Given any larger-cutoff endpoint X, first select its P11 modes and apply physical_project; G is evaluated after this P11 physical projection.
formula.coordinate_field: complex Fourier coefficients a_k in C^3 subject to a[-k]=conjugate(a[k]) and k dot a[k]=0; all derivatives are over the underlying real coordinate space
definitions: For ordered pair p=(l,r) with l+r=K and both modes in P11, let orbit(k)=sort(abs(k_1),abs(k_2),abs(k_3)); retain p iff (orbit(l),orbit(r)) is a frozen coefficient key.
D_g(a)=-sum_{p=(l,r) in g} P_K(i (r dot a_l) a_r).
G(a)=sum_g c_g n_g(a), with exact integer c_g stored in coefficient_rows.
formula.modes: all integer wavevectors (i,j,k) with i^2+j^2+k^2<=121, ordered lexicographically by i then j then k over -11..11; mode count 5575
formula.normalization: No ratio/normalizer in G. W=|K|^4=2025. Fourier convention u(x)=sum a_k exp(i k.x) on [0,2pi)^3; volume-normalized L2 squared is sum_k |a_k|^2.
formula.projection_Pk: for k!=0, P_k=I-k k^T/(k dot k); for k=0, identity as in galerkin.leray, while the endpoint physical_project convention sets the zero mode to zero and enforces reality by choosing the lexicographically canonical representative and conjugating its partner
formula.projection_rationality: P_K=I-K K^T/45; all fixed polynomial coefficients are exact rationals with powers of i and integer c_g; no floating normalizer enters G.

objective_name: signed C500 numerator on P11 using the frozen prospective N13 K36 sign chart
